walkthroughs.body_html: Signed 1959 (effective 1961) by 12 nations; now 56 parties (29 consultative with full voting rights). Suspends 7 territorial claims. Bans military activity, mining (under Madrid Protocol 1991). Scientific stations: 70 year-round; UK Halley VI on Brunt Ice Shelf. Tourism 105000 visitors 2022/23.

Adopted 1982; entered force 1994. Sets territorial seas (12 nm), contiguous zone (24 nm), EEZ (200 nm). High Seas Treaty (2023) for 30 percent ocean protection by 2030. International Seabed Authority oversees deep-sea mining (controversial: Nauru triggered 2-yr rule 2021).

Outer Space Treaty 1967 (113 parties): celestial bodies for peaceful use only, no national appropriation. Liability Convention 1972. Artemis Accords (2020) US-led for Moon exploration; China/Russia not party. Space debris (34000+ tracked objects) and satellite traffic raise new challenges.

mcqs.q: Madrid Protocol mining ban runs until review in:
Why can a cold winter NOT disprove climate change?
options: A megacity has over 1 million people and a world city has over 5 million.
Climate change only happens in summer.
A really cold winter proves global warming is not happening.
Climate is the long-term statistical average; a single cold winter is a weather event. Climate change is the trend in averages and extremes over decades, not the absence of cold days.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between a megacity and a world city?
options: A megacity has over 1 million people and a world city has over 5 million.
Megacities and world cities are the same thing.
A megacity is defined by population (over 10 million); a world city is defined by global economic and cultural influence (e.g. New York, London) — so a city can be one without the other.
Climate change only happens in summer.

mcqs.q: How do humans affect the carbon cycle?
options: By burning fossil fuels (releasing stored geological carbon to the atmosphere) and deforestation (reducing the biosphere store and releasing carbon).
Humans affect the carbon cycle by eating plants.
Humans only affect the carbon cycle by breathing out CO2.
Climate change only happens in summer.
